messages:
matt_support: Flagging an urgent handoff - tenant acme-corp failing during final provisioning step. Getting 503 -> backend_busy then 429 bursts. They have an investor demo at 16:00 PT and mentioned renewal conversation next week if onboarding stalls. Adding @sara_cs @elenia_am

sara_cs: On it. Can you paste the exact error payload and whether this affects only writes or also reads? Need to triage risk and craft a tight comms plan for the demo.

matt_support: Error snippets below:
```
POST /api/v1/tenants/acme-corp/provision -> 503 {"code":"backend_busy","detail":"request queued"}
subsequent replies: 429 {"rate":"tenant_quota"}
```
Looks like pool capacity + tenant rate limit interplay. No read impact; their dashboard can be shown if we enable a preview.

elenia_am: Thanks. I'll prep a short script for the demo that uses read flows if we can expose a preview. If not, we need to ask the customer to skip the provisioning step during the call. Also want to draft renewal reassurance language.

ryan_eng: Investigating. Early signal: autoscaler didn't pick up a scale event due to a misnamed policy (prod-scale vs production_scale). I can hotfix the policy name and bump pool by 2 GPUs. ETA ~30m.

sara_cs: Good. Proposed customer-facing plan for the demo (short bullets): 1) Be transparent about issue + ETA 30-45m, 2) Offer a read-only preview link so they can run the demo flows, 3) Commit to full provisioning update within 2 hours and a follow-up by email, 4) Include a renewal touch note offering an executive check-in. Thoughts?

matt_support: Agree. I can enable the preview flag and create a short pre-call note to send at 15:45 PT.

ryan_eng: Applied hotfix and scaled pool. Commands used:
```
kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -p '{"data":{"scale_policy":"production_scale"}}'
scale deployment/gpu-pool --replicas=6
```
Monitoring now.

matt_support: Enabled preview for tenant acme-corp:
```
/rf feature-flag set acme-corp provisioning_preview=true
```
Preview URL: https://preview.acme.acme.example.com (shared link). Sent provisional invite to the demo group.

ops-bot: autoscaler alert resolved for pool gpu-pool - mitigated by ryan_eng (duration ~18m)

ryan_eng: Observe reduced 429s, provisioning tasks now queue and complete. I'll keep an eye for errors for the next hour.

elenia_am: I'll join the demo at 15:50 to handle billing/renewal Qs and to walk through the proactive next steps post-demo. sara, want me to own the renewal note?

sara_cs: Please. I'll run the demo and recap the technical fix. Matt, mark ticket CS-ACME-9812 as monitoring and add notes on preview.

matt_support: Done. Ticket updated and set to monitoring. Customer confirmed they can run demo flows in preview and will proceed. They requested a written follow-up and a scheduled renewal prep call — I'll create a calendar invite.

sara_cs: Thanks team. After the call I'll send a short post-demo summary, the timeline of actions, and an enablement doc with next steps for full provisioning and best practices to avoid quota spikes. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident closed - duration 18m - owners: ryan_eng, matt_support
